We capture context from your daily life -- meetings, messages, browsing, notes -- and use it to help you remember everything, prioritize your day, and solve real problems. Think of us as the AI assistant that actually knows you. Check out the recent TechCrunch news on our $11M seed funding and what users are saying about the product. We're growing fast, and we're entering a phase where gut instincts need to be backed by rigorous data. That's where you come in. The Role We're looking for a sharp, stats-literate Analyst who can own product analytics end-to-end. We need someone with the judgment to know what questions to ask and the rigor to answer them properly. Generative AI can write SQL. It can calculate p-values. What it can't do is design the right experiment, catch a subtle confound in your cohort analysis, or connect a qualitative user signal to a quantitative pattern. That's the job. You'll work closely with our C-suite and product leadership to drive decisions on retention, engagement, conversion, and experimentation. What You'll Do Own experimentation. Design A/B tests with proper sample size calculations, power analysis, and significance testing. Run them. Interpret them. Flag when results are misleading. Analyze retention and engagement. Build and maintain cohort analyses, retention curves, and conversion funnels. Identify what separates users who stick from users who churn. Answer the hard questions. "Does Meeting Notes drive paid conversion, or do power users just happen to use it?" -- that kind of thing. Correlation vs. causation is your bread and butter. Define and track metrics. Help us build the right metrics framework for our stage. Know when a metric is vanity and when it's signal. Communicate findings clearly. Present insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders in a way that drives action, not confusion. Use LLMs as a force multiplier. We expect you to use AI tools aggressively for query generation, data wrangling, and visualization -- so you can spend your time on the thinking, not the typing. What We're Looking For Must-haves: 3-5 years of experience in product analytics, data analysis, or a quantitative role at a tech company (startup experience strongly preferred) Strong statistical foundations: hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, Bayesian reasoning, power analysis, regression. Not textbook knowledge -- practical application. Demonstrated ability to design and analyze A/B tests and other controlled experiments Sharp product intuition -- you think about why users behave a certain way, not just how Excellent written and verbal communication Nice-to-haves: Fluent in SQL. You'll be writing HogQL (ClickHouse-flavored SQL) against PostHog, so comfort with analytical SQL dialects is important. matches.d: This role sits within the Marketing Operations team and is a key enabler of a significant product transformation initiative. The Business Analyst will work directly in support of the Product Owner to drive the delivery of an agentic, conversational AI-powered tool designed to modernize and streamline marketing campaign intake, requirements creation, and campaign execution workflows. The successful candidate will serve as the connective tissue between business stakeholders and technology teams — translating marketing operational needs into precise, actionable requirements that fuel sprint-by-sprint delivery. This is a high-engagement role requiring someone who is equal parts rigorous analyst, collaborative partner, and detail-obsessed executor. This role is ideal for a professional who thrives in ambiguity, brings genuine intellectual curiosity about emerging AI capabilities, and is motivated by the opportunity to help shape how marketing campaigns are conceived, scoped, and brought to life through cutting-edge technology. Because this product is novel in concept and execution, the ideal candidate brings not just analytical discipline but also the creative and adaptive thinking needed to define problems and solutions that don't yet have established playbooks. Development Opportunities ●First-hand experience building and launching an enterprise-grade AI/agentic product from the ground up ●Deep cross-functional exposure spanning Marketing Operations, Technology, Risk, Legal, and Finance ●Opportunity to develop expertise at the intersection of MarTech, workflow automation, and conversational AI ●Visibility to senior leadership across marketing businesses and functions ●Long-term career paths across technology product and marketing operations domains Key Responsibilities Requirements & User Story Development Own the end-to-end coordination of all requirement packages to be handed off to Technology, ensuring completeness, clarity, and traceability Draft detailed technical requirements, well-structured user stories, and robust acceptance criteria for assigned workstreams Translate complex business and marketing operational needs into unambiguous, developer-ready specifications Proactively question and pressure-test requirements with stakeholders to surface gaps, edge cases, and unstated assumptions Agile Delivery Support Attend and actively contribute to all grooming sessions, ensuring backlog items are refined, estimated, and sprint-ready Support sprint planning and release planning activities in close partnership with the Product Owner and Scrum Master Review and sign off on sprint deliverables, validating that implemented features meet defined acceptance criteria Track and communicate sprint readiness status and flag risks or blockers to the Product Owner in a timely manner UAT & Quality Assurance Draft comprehensive UAT scripts and test scenarios that reflect real-world user journeys and edge cases Coordinate and facilitate UAT and usability testing sessions with business users and key stakeholders Document, triage, and manage defect logs; work with Technology to drive resolution prior to release Tool Migration & Change Management Support Support the migration of existing marketing programs and workflows into the new agentic tool platform, ensuring continuity and accuracy of business processes Contribute to the development of change management materials, training documentation, and user guides to enable smooth adoption Assist in coordinating training sessions and communications for impacted business users Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration Partner closely with marketing operations, technology teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to gather, validate, and refine business requirements Facilitate working sessions and workshops to drive alignment on scope, priorities, and solutions Maintain clear, structured documentation of decisions, open items, and action registers Qualifications Experience 6–9 years of experience in a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or related role within financial services or a comparably complex regulated industry Demonstrated experience in marketing operations or marketing campaign management environments, with a working understanding of campaign intake, execution workflows, and MarTech tools (e.g., Aprimo or comparable platforms) Experience working on workflow tool implementations or digital product builds , preferably involving process digitization or automation Proven track record of writing high-quality user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements in an Agile/Scrum delivery model Experience contributing to the build or launch of AI-powered, agentic, or conversational tools is highly desirable — including defining how AI interactions should behave, drafting prompt-adjacent logic flows, or writing requirements for ML/NLP-driven features Experience working in environments where the product or process did not yet exist — where the candidate helped define the "what" and "how" from scratch rather than incrementally improving an established system Technical & Functional Skills Functional technical literacy sufficient to engage meaningfully with engineering teams; ability to understand system integrations, APIs, data flows, and AI/LLM-driven system behaviors at a conceptual level — or demonstrated ability to rapidly acquire such knowledge Proficiency in Agile tools such as Jira for backlog management and sprint tracking Strong capability in requirements documentation tools and productivity suite (Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Visio, Confluence or equivalent) Experience with UAT planning and execution , including writing test scripts and managing defect tracking Familiarity with workflow automation platforms or enterprise SaaS tools is a plus; hands-on experience with AI-powered, conversational, or agentic tools — either as a builder, analyst, or power user — is a strong differentiator Comfort engaging with concepts such as prompt design, conversation flows, agent behaviors, and AI output validation even without a deep engineering background Core Competencies Critical thinking & analytical rigor: Ability to dissect ambiguous business problems and translate them into structured, precise requirements; comfortable challenging assumptions and asking the difficult questions to extract better information Meticulous attention to detail: Maintains high engagement and work quality throughout repetitive, process-intensive tasks without sacrificing thoroughness Independent working style: Able to take direction from the Product Owner and execute with limited hand-holding; self-manages workload and proactively identifies what needs to be done First-principles thinking: Demonstrates the ability to step back from conventional approaches and reason from the ground up — particularly valuable when building products where no direct precedent exists; not constrained by "how things have always been done" Intellectual curiosity & AI aptitude: Genuinely excited by the possibilities of AI and automation; stays informed on emerging capabilities and proactively considers how they could be applied to solve real business problems in Job Overview: As a Technical Project Manager at CAI, you will coordinate people and processes to ensure that our projects are delivered on time and produce the desired results. Technical Literacy: Solid fundamental understanding of back-end systems, complex, fully automated data flows, and computing technologies. System Debugging: Familiarity with reviewing server/application logs to track down software bugs or data pipeline failures. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Jira and Confluence for project tracking and documentation. Exposure to incident management, production support, or operational troubleshooting environments. Experience reviewing logs, debugging issues, and supporting root cause analysis. Production Support: Prior experience working in high-pressure incident management, site reliability, or production troubleshooting teams. matches.d: Product Analyst Overview The Product Analyst – Legacy Platform Modernization supports an assessment, requirements, solutioning, and AI-enabled prototyping effort to modernize a federal client's legacy loan servicing platform, migrate its capabilities to a modern enterprise platform, and plan the full decommissioning of the legacy environment. Working with the product lead and product managers, the analyst performs current-state analysis, stakeholder interviews, process mapping, capability assessments, and gap analysis; facilitates requirements workshops; and documents functional and non-functional requirements, business rules, and future-state processes for each loan servicing capability. The analyst maps integrations, dependencies, and data flows from source to screen, supports legacy function disposition analysis and evaluation of modernization and decommissioning alternatives, and contributes to AI-assisted analysis and prototyping. Success requires excellent written and verbal communication, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, the ability to shift priorities, leadership amid ambiguity, and proficiency with the Microsoft Suite. Key Functions Support the product lead and product managers with the legacy platform modernization assessment across the Requirements and Solutioning workstreams. Perform current-state analysis of the legacy platform, including its servicer portal, supporting databases, reporting services, external servicer integrations, and manual operational processes. Conduct stakeholder interviews and help plan and facilitate value stream sessions and requirements workshops with federal client business stakeholders, IT teams, and subject matter experts. Document current-state business processes and create process maps, customer journey maps, UI mockups/wireframes, and future-state process flows. Elicit and document functional and non-functional requirements (technical, operational, performance, security, and data access) for each loan servicing capability, including general and delinquent loan servicing, servicing quality reviews, claims processing, collections, loan purchase requests, property acquisitions, and post-audit reviews. Create epics, features, user stories, business rules, data mapping, and definitions of reports and communications, maintained in Jira and Confluence. Complete capability assessment checklists covering applications and tools in use, adjacent business processes, upstream and downstream integrations, correspondence and document services, shared services, and risks and constraints. Build integration and dependency maps and analyze application and business domain data requirements, understanding the data flow from source to screen. Identify requirements gaps, duplicate functionality, outdated requirements, and hidden business rules, and support legacy function disposition analysis (migrate, retire, automate, consolidate, defer, or replace). Support evaluation of modernization and decommissioning alternatives, including sequencing options, trade-offs, and implementation options analysis. Use approved AI-assisted tools to accelerate discovery, analysis, and documentation, including reverse-engineering requirements from legacy code and prototypes. Identify automation and process improvement opportunities, and capture employee performance and workforce considerations for impacted functional areas. Create high-quality client deliverables, such as requirements packages, assessment findings, and presentation materials, with regular supervision from the team lead. Be a good teammate to the client and the delivery team, encouraging and enabling teammates to be their best selves. Maintain positive relationships with the client. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree and 5 years of relevant experience. An additional 2 years of experience with an Associate's Degree. An additional 4 years of experience with a high school diploma. Experience with requirements elicitation and documentation, including user stories, business rules, and non-functional requirements. Experience with current-state analysis, process mapping, and gap analysis. Excellent verbal and written communications skills. Strong attention to detail with proven analytical and problem-solving skills. Can easily shift focus between high-priority tasks as required. Demonstrates leadership in the face of ambiguity, rather than waiting for direction from above. Navigates through challenges to consistently get things over the finish line. Proficiency with Microsoft Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). Preferred Qualifications or Skills Experience supporting federal loan servicing or benefits-delivery applications and legacy system modernization or migration efforts. Existing Public Trust clearance at a federal agency. In-depth knowledge of the mortgage industry, particularly loan servicing, loss mitigation, default, foreclosure, and claims processes. Familiarity with MISMO data standards and servicer reporting. Experience implementing Salesforce and/or AWS solutions for the federal government. Experience using AI-assisted tools for analysis, requirements, or documentation. Experience using JIRA and Confluence. matches.d: This role sits in the Product Management team within Sage Technology, the department responsible for building and maintaining the systems that run our business. You will report into Product Management and work alongside other product owners, product managers, engineers, and architects across the technology estate. Your product is Microsoft Dynamics CRM, and your internal customers are our college textbook sales and journal advertising sales divisions. Dynamics is where their pipeline is managed, customer relationships are tracked, and revenue decisions get made. You own the backlog for that platform and you are accountable for making it genuinely better for the people who depend on it every day. This is a role for a technologist with real commercial awareness. You will spend your time between two worlds: out in the business understanding what is slowing sales teams down, and back with your delivery team turning that into work that ships. Because Dynamics sits at the center of several business processes, you will also manage dependencies with other product teams inside Sage Technology. What you will do Own and prioritize the product backlog, making clear decisions about sequencing and trade-offs, and keeping the roadmap connected to both business objectives and the wider technology strategy. Build strong relationships with your internal customers in textbook sales and journal advertising sales, translating their needs into well-defined, valuable work for the delivery team. Lead discovery and validation. Talk to users, interrogate the data, and test assumptions before committing engineering effort. Partner closely with engineers and architects in Sage Technology, developing enough technical understanding of the platform to anticipate delivery risks and shape feasible solutions. Manage competing priorities and cross-team dependencies within the technology estate, negotiating openly when demands conflict and keeping stakeholders aligned on what is happening and why. Define what success looks like, then measure it. Use adoption data, performance metrics, and user feedback to judge whether changes actually worked. Contribute to the Product Management team's own practice, supporting your delivery team's agile ways of working and mentoring colleagues in good product habits. What you will bring 3-5 years of experience as a product owner, product manager, or in a comparable role, with hands-on responsibility for a backlog. If your experience sits slightly outside that range but you can show the capability, we would still like to hear from you. A track record of writing clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and running effective refinement with a delivery team. Strong stakeholder management. You can hold your ground with senior people, say no with a reason, and keep relationships intact. Confidence working with data to inform prioritization, and the critical thinking to question what the numbers are actually telling you. Experience working in agile delivery teams, ideally with colleagues in multiple locations and time zones. Genuine curiosity about the business you support and the users you serve. Preferred Requirements Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, or with another CRM platform such as Salesforce or HubSpot. Background in publishing, higher education, media, or advertising sales. Experience with system integrations, data migration, or the wider Microsoft Power Platform. Experience supporting teams through changes in process or tooling. Illness already asks enough of us. xCures® exists to give healthcare the capacity to care for everyone. Healthcare has more to give. Too much of its time, money, and talent goes into unnecessary work that keeps people waiting and drives up the cost of care. Freeing those resources can make excellent care possible for far more people. xCures understands a patient’s history across the places they receive care and keeps that understanding current. It puts trusted information in the hands of the people who need it, when they need it, and uses that knowledge to take on more of the administrative work around care. Every extracted data point traces back to the exact document and page it came from. Our ambition is to empower doctors to make better decisions, enable researchers to develop better treatments faster, and help healthcare organizations serve more people with fewer errors and lower costs. We work with diagnostic labs, providers, telehealth companies, health systems, payers, and consumer health platforms. We are a fully remote, venture-backed team that holds itself to the same standard as our product: trustworthy, precise, and purposeful. We are building for the lives people want to live. matches.d: About Pearl Founded in 2013, Pearl is a ratings and standards company building the national standard for home performance. Pearl SCORE™ rates every single-family home in the U.S. across five key pillars — Safety, Comfort, Operations, Resilience, and Energy — so homebuyers, homeowners, and real estate professionals can understand how a home performs in daily life. Today, the value of a home is judged by its location, size, and aesthetics— but these factors overlook the home’s most important function: safeguarding the comfort, well-being, and finances of the people inside. Most American homes underperform in these regards because home performance is simply not on our radar. We can’t see it, quantify it, or put a value on it. Pearl aims to change that by making home performance a central part of how we view and value our homes. We are not a home inspector, a contractor, a real estate platform, or a green-certification program — we rate homes against a transparent, evidence-based standard so that home performance becomes visible, measurable, and valuable in the real estate market. As a Certified B Corporation, we're accountable not only to our shareholders, but also to the homeowners and communities we serve. For more information, visit . Job Description reputed company's Product Management team is adding a Product Analyst for Prism. Prism is our conversational analytics platform. It lets the people who work in market access at life sciences companies ask questions about their data in plain English and get answers back in seconds, instead of handing the request to an analyst and waiting. Behind the scenes, Prism runs on semantic layers we build from our raw SQL data, and those layers are what let it take a business question and map it to the right numbers. The Product Analyst is the person who makes sure the questions people ask actually line up with the answers Prism gives back. You'll work day to day with Product Management, Data Science, and Engineering to keep those answers accurate and worth trusting. This isn't a development role, and it isn't about building reports or dashboards. It's an analysis role for someone who is technical but isn't a software engineer. You'll use reputed company reputed company along with tools like Claude and Codex to review and improve the prompts business users type into Prism and the answers it sends back. A lot of the work is finding the spots where the data is set up in a way that leads Prism to misread a question or return the wrong answer. Roughly half the job is digging into the data itself. The other half is talking to the business owners, certifying that queries return the right results, and writing up what needs to reputed company. What This Role Entails Prompt review Go through the prompts business users type into Prism and improve them, using reputed company reputed company and tools like Claude and Codex, so their questions get read correctly against the semantic layer. Query certification Check user queries and the answers Prism gives back, confirm they hold up against the source data, and sign off so the business can trust the results. Quality ownership Keep an eye on the questions users ask and the answers they get, and watch for repeat errors, gaps, or misreads so they get fixed. Semantic layer work Work with Data Science and Engineering to improve the semantic layers built from the raw SQL tables, including the taxonomies, metadata, and labeling, so Prism understands the data better. Data analysis Dig into how data connects across pricing, rebates, chargebacks, and other areas, and use what you find to shape how that data is represented in Prism. Working with the business Talk to business owners about the questions they need answered, and turn those conversations into better prompts, queries, and data structure. Writing requirements Write clear technical requirements for tuning the model, changing how data is structured, or reputed company the product, based on what your reviews turn up. Documentation Document where the data comes from, the business logic behind it, and how things relate, so people can understand and trust Prism's answers. Roadmap input Be the voice for data quality in planning and prioritization for Prism, so decisions are based on what the data actually says. QA and communication Work with QA to set up test reputed company for answer accuracy each sprint, and help with internal and customer updates (release notes, briefings, presentations) that explain how Prism works. Qualifications What You'll Bring to the Table At least 3 years in data analysis, data correlation, or similar analytical work. Strong technical skills without being a software engineer. You're comfortable with SQL, semantic layers, and data structures, and you can dig into a problem on your own. Hands-on experience with AI tools like reputed company reputed company, Claude, or Codex, and a good sense of how they read structured data and prompts. A working knowledge of semantic data modeling (ontologies, taxonomies, knowledge graphs, or similar) and how it supports AI querying. A knack for spotting when an AI answer doesn't match the source data, and the patience to figure out why. A track record of turning messy data relationships into clear requirements, working alongside Product Management, Data Science, and Engineering. Strong writing and speaking skills. You can talk to business owners and explain complicated data and AI ideas in a way people can act on. Experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar Agile tools. Role overview Our client is an Australian technology company whose AI voice agent platform answers and handles phone calls for businesses in Australia and New Zealand. As a Product Analyst , your responsibility is to research the AI voice agent market and turn it into clear, build-ready feature documents for our client's development team. This role is the bridge between the market and the product. You will study what competitors offer, analyse what the platform should build next, and write specifications the CTO can act on. The Founder & CEO makes final decisions on what gets built. Business owners create their own AI agents that can answer questions, book appointments, collect caller details, send SMS messages and transfer calls to staff. The platform is fully self-serve: customers set up and manage their agents, and handle any escalated calls themselves. The platform is built on its own technology stack using leading speech and language AI models, and is designed to work across industries. Key Responsibilities Market and competitor research Identify and track AI voice agent and call-handling platforms, globally and in Australia and New Zealand. Sign up for competitor free trials, build test agents and call demo numbers to experience their products first-hand. Monitor competitor feature releases, pricing changes, integrations and new market entrants. Feature analysis Break down how competitors design and deliver specific features, including user flows, settings and limitations. Assess which features are standard expectations and which could set the platform apart. Research third-party integrations (CRMs, calendars, booking systems, helpdesks) and how they connect to voice agent platforms. Feature documentation Write clear, structured feature specification documents using the client's standard format. Present feature documents to the Founder & CEO for review and approval. Hand approved specifications to the CTO and answer the development team's questions about them. Keep a prioritised feature backlog up to date. Platform insight Review anonymised call transcripts and recordings to spot where agents struggle or callers get confused. Analyse platform usage data, such as feature adoption and drop-off during agent setup. Review support tickets and cancellation feedback for recurring issues and feature requests. Product quality Test new features once built against the approved specification and report gaps. Help maintain product documentation and help-centre content for new features. Requirements Skills and Experience Essential 1–3 years in a product analyst, business analyst, QA or similar role at a software or SaaS company. Excellent written English, with the ability to write clear, structured documents for both business and technical readers. Strong research and analytical skills, with a habit of testing products hands-on rather than relying on marketing pages. Ability to understand software features and user flows, and explain them simply. Confident using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for research, analysis and drafting. Organised and self-directed, able to manage several research topics at once and meet agreed deadlines. Reliable home internet and a quiet workspace suitable for remote work. Desirable Familiarity with AI voice agents, chatbots or conversational AI products. Basic understanding of APIs and how software integrations work. Work Environment & Expectations While this is a work-from-home position, it is important to note that this is a full-time role—not a freelance or flexible-hour arrangement. You will be expected to work a fixed shift and maintain a high level of professionalism and accountability, just as you would in an office environment. ✅ This role requires: Discipline and commitment to set working hours (strict shift times, not flexible) Use of time tracking software during work hours Active participation in team and client calls with your camera ON Consistent availability and responsiveness throughout your shift Treating this as a long-term, full-time job—not a side gig or freelance task ⏱Payroll is processed bi-monthly. matches.d: Job Description A bit about this role: Devoted Health engages in millions of member interactions every year through a frontline organization of team members and AI agents spanning Member Service, Specialty Care Coordination, and Member Outreach, Sales and more. The quality of those interactions is the mission. Every call, every outreach, every touchpoint is a moment where we either earn or lose a member's trust. Getting this right at scale requires a fundamentally new approach. You will build AI systems that monitor the quality of every member interaction and turn those signals into coaching and feedback that elevates both frontline team performance and frontline AI agent performance. You will define what high performance looks like across these teams and AI agents and build the systems that ensure we hit our goals. You will be a close thought partner to the leaders of our frontline teams, ensuring that every tool you build is adopted and helps them meaningfully improve performance. This is a new role, and you will shape what AI-native quality and performance operations looks like for this organization. Your Responsibilities and Impact will include: Embed with frontline teams and their leaders to understand what quality looks like in practice: how members are engaged, where interactions break down, and how coaching happens (or doesn't) today. Own the performance of our highest volume frontline AI agents, across voice and chat, and continue to build out those agents to drive higher performance. Build AI-powered quality monitoring systems that move the needle on our most important business outcomes. Evaluate member interactions in real time across millions of touchpoints, moving beyond pass/fail scoring to nuanced assessment of what actually matters for member experience, safety, and outcomes. Build coaching workflows that surface actionable feedback to leaders at all levels immediately, making every interaction an opportunity to improve. Every key stakeholder should have an approach to action on results so that we’re getting better every day. Visualize interaction data, evaluation criteria, coaching signals, and performance trends so the right insight reaches the right person at the right time, from rep to team lead to senior leader. Scale what works. Turn successful systems into reusable frameworks that extend to new teams, interaction types, and channels. What works for Member Service should accelerate what you build for Specialty Care Coordination, Member Outreach, and our Clinician orgs. Partner closely with frontline team leaders across levels, coaching them on how to use the tools you build, ensuring adoption, and iterating in real time in response to their feedback to drive value. Oversee a small team of operators and agent builders that will drive performance across all frontline agents and teams Required skills and experience: 4+ years in high-ownership operator roles: startup strategy, biz ops, consulting, or internal tooling PM. You have built and run systems that made organizations meaningfully more effective, and you move quickly to working prototypes on real data with real feedback. People leadership experience: you have directly managed, mentored, or grown individuals or teams, and you bring that lens to every cross-functional partnership. You know how to build trust quickly, give feedback that lands, and create the conditions for people around you to do their best work. Fluency with modern AI tools and platforms, with an active practice of pushing their limits. You're adaptive and curious — willing to learn, teach, lead, and follow. Strong data fluency: You self-serve analysis and reason from data rigorously: you know which numbers actually drive the business, can spot when a metric is misleading, and turn ambiguous data into clear insights on quality. Systems thinking: you move from solving a single issue to designing a framework that prevents an entire category of issues. You generalize your work and think in feedback loops, not isolated fixes. An instinct for quality in human interactions: you translate intuition about what a good member experience feels like into structured criteria an AI system can apply at scale. You care deeply about doing what's right for members and the teams serving them. A coaching and enabling mindset: you work with frontline managers and quality leads to ensure AI-generated insights actually change behavior. You challenge assumptions, do what makes sense even when it's unconventional, and care more about outcomes than credit. Exceptional communication: you tailor your style to move teams to action, from frontline guides to executives. You're comfortable with ambiguity and take ownership of outcomes end to end. Built on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, our applications help customers improve visibility, efficiency, and operational scalability. Overview Leads the design, development, testing, release, and support of complex Business Central and cross-platform mobile solutions. Serves as a technical leader by making sound design decisions, mentoring developers, resolving difficult technical problems, and improving engineering quality and delivery practices. What This Position Owns Visioning and Competitive Intelligence (20%): Shape domain direction using market signals, customer insight, and competitor analysis; propose strategic bets, positioning updates, and sequencing changes tied to business outcomes. Backlog and Sprint Readiness (15%): Own backlog health by prioritizing and preparing work so items are sprint-ready with clear scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and delivery sequencing. Stakeholder and Cross-Team Alignment (10%): Align Product, Engineering, Support, Sales, and Implementation on priorities, timing, tradeoffs, and customer commitments so execution and messaging remain consistent. Customer Discovery and Validation (15%): Engage users and customers, including dispatchers, technicians, and service managers, to validate problems, test assumptions, and convert learning into better priorities and requirements. Solutioning and Tradeoff Work (10%): Partner with Engineering to evaluate solution options and make practical decisions across customer value, effort, risk, scalability, and time to value. Escalations and Issue Triage (10%): Lead or coordinate priority customer and product issue response, including triage, decision-making, stakeholder communication, and prevention actions that reduce recurrence. Quality Validation and Platform Release Readiness (10%): Confirm product behavior through UAT support, regression validation, and release-impact checks; stay current on major platform releases and features to protect compatibility and identify product opportunities. Documentation Review and Enablement Readiness (5%): Verify release documentation is accurate, complete, and usable across customer-facing guides, internal support notes, and enablement materials. KPI Review and Outcome Tracking (5%): Monitor adoption and service-performance metrics, interpret outcome trends, and feed learning back into roadmap and backlog decisions. How Success Is Measured Success is measured by backlog health and sprint readiness; quality of product decisions and cross-team alignment; validated customer learning; timely resolution of priority issues; release quality and platform compatibility; documentation readiness; feature adoption; service-performance trends; and measurable movement in product and business outcomes. Responsibilities Build and maintain a fact-based product-domain perspective using customer feedback, support patterns, market signals, competitive research, platform changes, and performance data. Propose product bets, positioning changes, and roadmap sequencing updates with a clear connection to customer and business outcomes. Own and continuously prioritize the backlog based on customer value, strategic fit, revenue impact, risk, technical health, effort, and time to value. Translate priorities into sprint-ready work with clear problem statements, scope, user stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and sequencing. Lead backlog refinement and provide timely product decisions before and during development. Plan and conduct discovery with relevant users and customers, document findings, test assumptions, and incorporate validated learning into requirements and priorities. Partner with Engineering to evaluate solution options, understand technical constraints, and make explicit tradeoff decisions. Align Support, Sales, Implementation, Product, and Engineering on priorities, timing, customer commitments, release impact, and messaging. Lead or coordinate triage for priority product and customer issues, including decision-making, stakeholder updates, and prevention follow-up. Support UAT, regression validation, and release-impact reviews to confirm that product behavior meets expectations. Monitor major Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and related platform releases for compatibility risks and product opportunities. Approve completed work against acceptance criteria and intended customer outcomes before release. Review customer-facing documentation, internal support notes, release communications, and enablement materials for accuracy and readiness. Monitor adoption and service KPIs, interpret trends, and use the findings to adjust roadmap, backlog, discovery, and enablement decisions. Strong capability in customer discovery, competitive analysis, requirements definition, backlog management, facilitation, stakeholder communication, issue triage, UAT, and data-informed decision-making. Experience with SaaS, ERP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, and rental, service, field-service, or industrial-asset workflows is strongly preferred. Role requirements: - Complex SaaS Implementation & Project Management: You have deep experience contributing to or owning implementation projects for complex SaaS products (actioning a defined project plan, communicating and aligning with stakeholders on progress, and ultimately delivering results in accordance with the agreed upon expectations). You don’t rely on ‘I’ve seen this done,’ but instead think critically to solve problems. You anticipate how configuration decisions might impact customer goals, ask questions to validate options, and pair your recommendations with risk mitigation tactics. - Best Practices & Recommendations: You take pride in advising customers on best practices specific to their usage of software to ensure optimal value. - Change Management: You are experienced in navigating change management processes and helping customers adapt to new systems and a refreshed approach. - Cross-functional Collaboration and Communication: You effectively partner with cross-functional stakeholders across Customer Success, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Operations to align and define progress. You proactively communicate progress and risks with internal and external stakeholders. You could be a great fit if: - 🙋You strike the balance between collaborative teamwork with a strong ability to execute independently on a defined plan. - 📣 You demonstrate clear communication. You ask clarifying questions with precision and can distill complex concepts into simple themes. - 🎧 You are a great listener. You read between the lines of what customers share in order to identify core concepts, which allows you to surface the right tailored recommendations. You see your role as the voice of the customer to internal stakeholders so we can ensure that our offerings continue to evolve in accordance with customer needs. - 📈 You are a problem solver. OUR PHILOSOPHY: Here are a few key points that should give you a sense of what it’s like to work with us: - We invest heavily in building best-in-class products, believing that great products make customer success easier and more meaningful. - We value deep expertise and thoughtful problem-solving in every customer interaction. - We believe small, highly capable teams outperform large teams — and we hire, support, and compensate accordingly. - We value ownership, principled thinking, and clear communication, regardless of tenure or level. matches.d: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. At Vanta, our mission is to secure the internet and protect consumer data. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. Our goal is to provide best-in-class Technical Support to our customers. Our team's mission: "We transform complexity into clarity in every interaction, with empathy, earning the trust of our customers" We build strong partnerships with our customers through trust and transparency, which is why our Technical Support Metrics https://www.vanta.com/technical-support-metrics are public. As the AI Agent Operations Specialist,You'll own Ask-Ilma, Vanta's customer-facing AI agent, built on Fin by Intercom, and the first point of contact for customers seeking support.. You're accountable for whether customers get the right answer, how the experience feels, and how smoothly Fin hands off to our support engineers when it should. Our customers rely on Vanta to get compliance right, so a fast answer only counts if it's also a correct one. This is a hands-on role for someone who treats an AI agent like a product: something to measure, tune, test, and improve every week. What you’ll do as a AI Optimization Specialist, Support at Vanta: PERFORMANCE: OWN HOW WELL FIN WORKS An AI agent's performance drifts without a clear owner, and that owner is you. You'll have a bias for action, shipping improvements quickly and learning from the results. You'll also decide with frameworks, so the team always understands why one fix came before another. - Review Fin conversations weekly to find wrong answers, self-service gaps, and avoidable escalations. - Make changes in Fin yourself (guidance, content, workflows). Treat most as two-way doors: ship, measure, adjust. - Keep a ranked list of improvements based on customer impact, volume, and risk. - Set and document Fin's guardrails: what it must never answer, when it asks a clarifying question, and when it escalates. KNOWLEDGE: OWN WHAT FIN KNOWS Fin is only as accurate as what it knows. Our customers trust Vanta to get compliance right, and we do what it says on the tin, so Fin's knowledge has to be correct and current. - Own the knowledge Fin draws from: snippets, internal content, and our help center. - Set the governance: every topic has an owner and a review cadence, and outdated or conflicting content gets retired. - When a support engineer answers something Fin couldn't, turn it into reusable knowledge so we only answer it once. - Set AI-ready content standards, and partner with Customer Education to bring help-center articles up to them. CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE: OWN HOW FIN FEELS TO CUSTOMERS For many customers, Fin is the first Vanta "teammate" they talk to. Because we put our customers first, how Fin makes them feel matters as much as what it says. - Shape how Fin sounds, including how it says "I don't know" without leaving customers stuck. - Own handoffs: when Fin escalates, where it routes, and what context it passes so customers never repeat themselves. - Dig into low CSAT ratings and dead ends, and fix the root cause. - Handle a small volume of tickets to stay close to real customer problems. LAUNCH READINESS: OWN FIN'S READINESS FOR EVERY LAUNCH Vanta ships fast, and customers ask about new features the day they launch. We win as one team and lead with resilience, so Fin is ready on day one, even when plans change late. - Partner early with Product, Engineering, and Customer Education to get source-of-truth content before features ship. - Have Fin tested and ready on launch day, then watch closely and close gaps fast. - Evaluate new Fin capabilities and recommend which to adopt. How to be successful in this role: - Support expertise: 3+ years in technical support at a B2B SaaS company, including troubleshooting complex customer issues. TSS / Sr. TSS experience is preferred. - AI support tool experience: hands-on experience with AI-powered support tools, as a user or an admin, and a clear view of where they work well and where they don't. - Structured writing: you can turn a messy process into clear, well-organized knowledge that both people and AI can use. - Data-driven decisions: you're comfortable pulling and interpreting performance data, spotting trends, and using them to decide what to fix first. - Systems thinking: when you see a bad answer, you ask what in the system caused it, then fix that so it doesn't happen again. - Customer judgment: you can tell when an answer is technically right but still a bad experience, and when a customer needs a person. - Nice to have: Experience administering Intercom and Fin, including guidance, snippets, Procedures, or AI Insights. - Nice to have: Background in knowledge management, content design, or writing for conversational interfaces. - Nice to have: Experience leading a support tool rollout or migration. - Nice to have: Exposure to security, compliance, or GRC concepts. - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. - Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship. What you can expect as a Vanta’n: - Industry-competitive salary and equity - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents - Health & wellness stipend - Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend - Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office - Family planning benefits - Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting - Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time - 11 company-paid holidays - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events! - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials. #LI-remote At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply. About Vanta We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent. matches.d: Join us as we transform immunology and deliver medicines that help autoimmune patients get their lives back. argenx is preparing for multi-dimensional expansion to reach more patients through a rich pipeline of differentiated assets, led by VYVGART, our first-in-class neonatal Fc receptor blocker approved for the treatment of gMG, and with the potential to treat patients across dozens of severe autoimmune diseases. We are building a new kind of biotech company, one that maintains its roots as a science-based start-up and pushes our commitment to innovate across all corners of our business. We strive to inspire and grow our company, our partnerships, our science, and our people, because when we do, we deliver more for patients. For the expansion of our international DT Commercial team, argenx is looking for Product Owner – DT Commercialization - DT Medical Affairs. This role will own the technology vision and value delivery for our Medical Affairs and Evidence Generation capability within Digital Technology (DT) Commercial. It is accountable for translating the goals of our Medical Affairs and Evidence Generation teams into a clear product vision and a prioritized backlog for platforms that support scientific exchange. By acting as the primary liaison between medical experts and technical teams, ensuring all solutions meet key compliance standards, and enabling the use of technology to generate insights, this position is directly responsible for ensuring our digital ecosystem supports effective and compliant medical engagement. Roles & Responsibilities Own the digital product vision and prioritize the backlog for key Medical Affairs and Evidence Generation platforms, including Medical CRM and scientific exchange tools. Act as the primary medical-to-tech liaison, translating complex scientific engagement and evidence generation needs into clear, actionable user stories. Ensure all digital solutions strictly adhere to non-promotional regulations and medical integrity standards, embedding compliance into the design process. Drive the development of tools and analytics to capture and analyze global medical insights, enabling data-driven strategic decision-making for Medical Affairs and Evidence Generation leadership. Act as the steward for the end-to-end user experience for Medical Affairs and Evidence Generation platforms, ensuring they are intuitive and effective for field medical teams and HCPs. Define and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for success, continuously measuring the value and impact of the technology on scientific engagement objectives. Provide clear, day-to-day direction to various delivery teams on what to build next, ensuring alignment with Medical Affairs priorities. Serve as the primary point of contact for delivery teams, providing constant feedback and clarification on medical requirements to empower effective execution. Skills and Competencies Deep knowledge of product management principles, particularly in defining a product vision and strategy that aligns with Medical Affairs and Evidence Generation goals. Skilled in translating complex scientific or medical business needs into clear requirements and user stories for technical teams. Ability to own and prioritize a product backlog based on scientific value and strategic importance within a regulated pharmaceutical environment. Expert knowledge of the legal and regulatory compliance framework governing non-promotional activities and scientific exchange in the pharmaceutical industry. Knowledge of the digital technologies that support Medical Affairs and Evidence Generation, such as Medical CRM and platforms for insight gathering and scientific content dissemination. Ability to work collaboratively and effectively together within cross-functional teams and networks. Demonstrated communication skills, within a multi-cultural and multi-lingual global environment. Is agile and demonstrates adaptability, comfort with ambiguity, trust-building, and resilience. Drives toward outcomes. Ambitious, inquisitive naturally, a quick study, with demonstrated eagerness to continuously learn, self-improve and develop. This includes being comfortable giving and receiving feedback in a diverse environment. Passionate and prepared to lead and contribute to our culture, which is driven by our corporate values of co-creation, innovation, empowerment, excellence, and humility. Education, Experience & Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master Degree preferred in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Information Technology, Business Administration, or related fields. 5+ Years experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Business Analyst with a focus on delivering solutions for Medical Affairs, Clinical, or R&D functions. 5+ Years experience in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry, with a strong understanding of Medical Affairs and Evidence Generation business processes and compliance requirements. 5+ Years experience owning a product roadmap and using KPIs to measure and communicate the value of technology solutions to scientific or medical stakeholders. matches.d: About Aspira For more than 40 years, Aspira has been the market-leading provider of software and services that help public agencies protect natural and cultural resources while making them accessible for all. Our platform supports everything from campground reservations to hunting licenses, helping millions of people discover, enjoy, and care for the outdoors. We share our client partners’ mission: to steward resources for future generations, create opportunities for genuine enjoyment of the outdoors today, and expand access so more people can experience its benefits. Aspira is transforming its technology and service model to give agencies more capacity and insight—streamlined tools, smarter automation, and better connections with their communities. Our goal is simple: make it easier for our clients to conserve what matters most and for their customers to enjoy it to the fullest. FYI Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Aspira is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas, now or in the future. As part of our hiring process, candidates may be required to complete an identity verification check conducted through Checkr, a secure third-party service provider. This step helps confirm the authenticity of applicant identities and supports a fair, secure hiring process for all candidates. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this notice and consent to the potential inclusion of an identity verification step as part of the interview process. The Ideal Candidate The Client Delivery Project Manager (PM) is a versatile, technically fluent, client-focused project management role responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering work across the full client lifecycle. This includes RFPs, contracting, implementations, platform transitions, production migrations, renewals, and ad hoc client initiatives. As part of Aspira 's PMO, Client Delivery Project Managers act as the operational backbone for client-facing work, partnering closely with Account Management, Product, Engineering, Transition, Implementation, Legal, Finance, and Leadership. They bring clarity to complex efforts, reduce risk during periods of change, and continuously improve how Aspira delivers for clients. Key Responsibilities Implementation & Platform Migration Management Own a variety of implementation projects end-to-end, including feature implementations for existing clients, new client implementations, new platform migrations, and client transition-out projects. Lead project kickoffs and maintain a regular governance cadence, including status calls, risk and issue tracking, and executive updates, to keep stakeholders aligned throughout each project. Maintain detailed project plans, timelines, milestones, and dependency tracking across all implementation, migration, and transition-out work. Identify risks, blockers, and decision points early; escalate and drive resolution to maintain momentum. Manage change requests when project work expands beyond the signed Scope of Work, keeping the client and internal teams aligned on the impact to scope and timeline. Coordinate end-user training, communication, and enablement materials so client teams feel confident and equipped to adopt new features, platforms, or transitions at go-live. Own user acceptance testing coordination and go-live readiness sign-off, including a post-launch hypercare period to confirm stability before formal project close. Ensure every implementation, migration, or transition-out project is organized, predictable, and client-centered. End-to-End Client Lifecycle Management Create a cohesive, consistent client experience across the full lifecycle, from RFP through implementation, migration, renewal, and (if needed) transition-out, coordinating with Aspira 's internal teams throughout. Serve as a continuity anchor for clients, ensuring smooth handoffs between lifecycle phases and teams. Partner closely with Account Management to translate contracts, statements of work, and commitments into actionable, sequenced project plans, and maintain a strong working relationship with the client partnership team throughout. Support ad hoc client initiatives by applying consistent project management practices to maintain predictability and quality. RFP & Proposal Execution Lead RFPs as formal projects, responsible for planning, sequencing, and execution. Coordinate cross-functional contributors (Account Management, Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Leadership). Assign writers and reviewers, track inputs and dependencies, and manage deadlines. Review and edit responses for clarity, consistency, and alignment with client needs. Plan and coordinate demos, including scoping, scripting, scheduling, and readiness tracking. Continuously improve RFP processes through templates, standards, and repeatable workflows. Revenue Growth & Upsell Support upsell of previously released modules within the existing client base, partnering with Account Management to identify adoption gaps and build the case for expansion. Create and maintain project templates for enabling existing modules, so features that have already been built can be turned on quickly without a full new implementation cycle. Track module adoption across the client base and use that data to help prioritize which upsell opportunities to pursue next. Cross-Functional Coordination Act as a central point of coordination across Product, Engineering, Implementation, Transition, Account Management, and external partners. Coordinate with external vendors and third-party partners involved in implementation or migration work, ensuring their deliverables stay aligned with the overall project timeline and scope. Take ownership of resolving cross-team conflicts in priority or timing. Maintain clarity around ownership, expectations, and timelines across all workstreams. Documentation, Standards & Operational Excellence Document end-to-end client lifecycle and implementation workflows for internal reference and onboarding. Establish and maintain templates, playbooks, timelines, and best practices. Maintain accurate, current project documentation, client records, and delivery artifacts so every project stays organized and easy to hand off. Follow Aspira 's PMO-established standards, templates, and processes, while contributing frontline project experience back into the PMO to continuously refine and enhance those methods. Drive continuous improvement across internal workflows and cross-functional collaboration. Qualifications Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional projects such as RFPs, implementations, migrations, or transitions. Strong organizational, documentation, and process improvement skills. Comfortable coordinating across technical and non-technical teams. Clear, confident communicator with strong client-facing skills. Adaptable, emotionally intelligent, and able to thrive in an evolving environment. Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technical concepts and systems, and to take ownership without waiting for direction. Prior experience implementing or supporting SaaS platforms (implementation, onboarding, or platform migration work). Working knowledge of data migration concepts: environment tiers (DEV/QA/UAT/PROD), data validation and reconciliation, cutover, and rollback planning. Familiarity with the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including sprint or release cycles, backlog and ticket management, and QA/testing phases, sufficient to plan around and coordinate effectively with Product and Engineering. Comfort reading and translating technical documentation, such as tickets, release notes, and migration plans, for non-technical stakeholders. Desired Hardware and Software Competencies Proficiency in Monday.com or an equivalent project management platform for day-to-day project management. Proficiency in Jira, used to track engineering-owned work such as tickets and releases. Experience with Confluence, Microsoft 365, or similar tools. Desired Education and Experience Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. PMP, CAPM, or equivalent project management certification. 3-5 years of project management, program management, or client delivery experience (SaaS, GovTech, services, or large-scale change initiatives preferred). Exposure to system implementations or platform migrations requiring careful documentation and cross-team coordination. Experience supporting RFP responses, proposal writing, or account growth and upsell initiatives. Experience working within a PMO or standardized project governance structure. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum practices; Scrum Master or related certification a plus. Equal Employment Opportunity RA Outdoors, LLC dba Aspira is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Aspira is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs and practices, consistent with applicable law. matches.d: Bamboo Health is the leader in Real-Time Care Intelligence™ solutions aimed at improving lives for everyone experiencing physical and behavioral health challenges. We are driven by our mission to empower clients to deliver seamless, high-quality and cost-effective care during pivotal moments to improve health outcomes. From coast to coast, Bamboo Health partners with all major retail pharmacy chains, 52 states and territories, 100% of the top 10 best hospitals and more than half of the country’s largest health plans to improve more than 1 billion patient encounters annually. Join us in improving lives during pivotal care moments! Summary: As a Sr. Technical Project Lead, you will lead complex HL7 integrations across EHRs, hospitals, State Health Information Exchanges (HIEs), and third-party data partners, expanding and supporting connectivity across our nationwide healthcare network. In this role, you will serve as the primary technical liaison partnering closely with internal and external stakeholders to drive successful implementations and ensure alignment across technical requirements, business objectives, project scope, and delivery timelines. Your work will be crucial in enhancing interoperability, strengthening the exchange of real-time, actionable patient care events, and advancing data-sharing capabilities across the healthcare ecosystem. You will support the ongoing technical health of a portfolio of accounts by proactively managing integrations, monitoring risk, and helping ensure successful customer outcomes. This is a highly visible, cross-functional role requiring close collaboration with Engineering, Growth, Account Management, Implementation, Product, and Support. What You’ll Do: Lead the technical implementation of Bamboo Health HL7 product offerings for healthcare entities, executing test plans, analyzing message structure and data quality, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating with Engineering and external partners through production launch Function as a subject matter expert on specifications across customers segments ensuring that all technical and business requirements are met during the integration process Build and maintain subject matter expertise on Bamboo Health ’s products as team expertise evolves. Serve as the Technical Account Manager for assigned Tier 1 accounts, providing ongoing oversight of complex integrations, proactive communication of technical risks, and resolution of integration issues. Partner with data sources and internal teams to maintain HL7 mappings, implement configuration changes, and ensure reliable connectivity and data exchange Proactively identify implementation risks, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement, partnering with technical teams to develop scalable and sustainable solutions Address high-priority customer escalations, applying SQL-based data analysis to identify root causes and guide internal and external stakeholders toward resolution Use AI and automation tools to accelerate documentation, status reporting, and other administrative work, and surface new use cases as they emerge (e.g., summarization, task routing, or data parsing). Stay curious about emerging AI tools and how they can streamline or enhance work within your function. What Success Looks Like… In 3 months… Develop a strong understanding of Bamboo Health products, integration workflows, and HL7 onboarding processes. Support active implementations through mapping, testing, validation, and issue resolution activities. Build relationships with key customers, partners, and internal stakeholders. Begin incorporating AI-supported tools into your day-to-day work—whether through analysis, documentation, or task management. In 6 months… Independently manage technical implementation phases of integration projects, ensuring that Bamboo Health ’s integration requirements are met and project documentation is accurate Provide subject matter expertise to key stakeholders on integrations, ensuring seamless data exchange Assume Technical Account Manager ownership for assigned Tier 1 accounts, serving as a trusted technical resource for customers, HIE partners, and internal stakeholders. Contribute to Technical Services quality initiatives, including the development, tracking, and reporting of key performance and data-quality metrics. In 12 months… Manage complex implementation projects through delivery, proactively identifying opportunities to strengthen technical partnerships and improve processes leading to quality outcomes Serve as a trusted Technical Account Manager and HL7 subject matter expert for Tier 1 accounts, proactively managing integration health and technical escalations Drive improvements across Technical HL7 Services by leveraging quality metrics and integration trends to identify opportunities for greater data quality, efficiency, scalability, and standardization What You Need: A mission-driven focus with a passion for spearheading change in complex healthcare environments 5+ years of professional experience independently managing healthcare projects involving cross-functional internal and external stakeholders with excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail Proven experience with HL7 standards and specifications is required Experience with integration engines (such as Mirth) is a plus Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships and collaborate across technical and non-technical stakeholders in a remote environment focused on empathy, self-awareness, and respect for others Proficient in writing and executing SQL queries to analyze large data sets High proficiency in Microsoft 365 for creating reports, presentations, and managing communications Experience with Atlassian products (Jira and Confluence) for project management, team collaboration, and knowledge sharing Proficiency with Salesforce products is a plus BA/BS degree or equivalent experience Comfort using or learning AI-supported tools (e.g., ChatGPT, CoPilot, or role-specific tools) to improve daily workflows. A forward-thinking, curious mindset with an openness to experimenting with new technologies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to apply sound technical judgement in providing solutions Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-growth, and rapidly evolving environments. Ability to work effectively in a remote-first environment, ensuring high-quality virtual interactions with minimal distractions. The ability to travel periodically for work What You Get: Join one of the most innovative healthcare technology companies in the country. Have the autonomy to build something with an enthusiastically supportive team. Learn from working at the highest levels and on the most strategic priorities of the company, including from world class investors and advisors. Receive competitive compensation including health, dental, vision and other benefits. Belonging at Bamboo We Care. #BambooHealthValuesCare Every human being has the right to the best possible healthcare. Our Real-Time Care Intelligence™ solutions enable healthcare professionals to see and treat every individual as a whole person by providing the right information, at the right time – regardless of physical, behavioral or social barriers. We’re a great place to work because we care. We continually seek to learn about our differences and ensure the unique perspectives and contributions of all employees are welcome, valued and celebrated. Our commitment to making a positive impact starts by recognizing and leveraging our differences, building inclusive teams and cultivating a sense of belonging. Bamboo Health is proud to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. By connecting to vehicles, chargers, batteries, solar, and other distributed energy resources, we turn households into flexible grid assets that balance supply and demand, preventing blackouts and reducing reliance on fossil fuels. We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to own those relationships end-to-end — the connective tissue between our commercial team, our external partners, and our engineering and product teams.
